items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Not Simon Fraser. That was a cousin or something like that. Smitty. Smitty.

ctx.x: Not Simon Fraser. That was a cousin or something like that. Smitty. Smitty. I can't think he was last name. The one that was that Sunday. And had a fella by the name of Lionel Favos playing trumpet.
That guitar player huh wasn't it? Huh? Wasn't that guitar player too? No.
